title: Spoofing of external entity
description: An attacker may impersonate an external entity to gain unauthorized access.

title: Spoofing of internal process
description: A malicious process may impersonate a legitimate internal process.

title: Tampering with data in transit
description: Data may be intercepted and modified while traversing the network.

title: Tampering with data at rest
description: Data stored in the database or file system may be modified unauthorizedly.

title: Repudiation of action
description: A user may deny performing an action due to lack of sufficient logging.

title: Repudiation of receipt
description: A receiver may deny receiving a message.

title: Exposure of sensitive data in logs
description: Sensitive information may be inadvertently written to system logs.

title: Exposure of sensitive data in error messages
description: Detailed error messages may reveal implementation details.

title: Data leakage via unencrypted channel
description: Sensitive data transmitted over HTTP or other cleartext protocols.

title: Resource exhaustion
description: An attacker may consume all available resources (CPU, memory, disk) rendering the system unavailable.

title: Network flooding
description: An attacker may flood the network interface with traffic.

title: Privilege escalation via implementation flaw
description: An attacker gains higher privileges than authorized due to a bug.

title: Privilege escalation via misconfiguration
description: An attacker gains higher privileges due to insecure configuration defaults.

title: DNS Spoofing
description: Attacker poisons the DNS cache to redirect traffic.

title: Code Injection
description: Attacker modifies executable code or scripts.

title: Audit log deletion
description: Attacker deletes audit logs to cover their tracks.

title: Side-channel attack
description: Attacker infers information from timing or power consumption.

title: Account lockout DoS
description: Attacker intentionally locks out legitimate users by guessing passwords.

title: DLL Hijacking
description: Attacker places a malicious DLL in a directory searched by the application.

title: Parameter Tampering
description: Attacker modifies URL parameters or form fields.
